Each table below is exactly as its author submitted it,
`r if (is_locked()) "sealed at" else "and will be sealed at"`
**`r fmt_when(CONFIG$lock_time)`**. The *Actual* column is where that club sits
in the live table right now, and *Off by* is the damage.

```{r sections, results='asis'}
# Same order as the side-by-side grid on the front page, so the two pages can
# be read against each other. Each entrant's current rank is in their pills.
ordered <- entrant_order(PLAYERS)

chunks <- character(0)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ordered))) {
  .row <- ordered[i, ]
  knitr::opts_knit$set(unnamed.chunk.label = paste0("player", i))
  chunks <- c(chunks, knitr::knit_child("_player_section.Rmd",
                                        envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE))
}
cat(chunks, sep = "\n\n---\n\n")
```
